description: Searches the Press Room catalog for PR and press release distribution and digital PR: newswire packages (including PR Newswire packages), PR distribution packages, single news sites that publish a press release or a supplied article (sponsored articles, guest posts and other editorial media placements), bundles, monthly programs and services. Filters by product type, category, region, language, highest price, dofollow and lowest DR (Ahrefs), and can rank for a goal or a goal mix. Each result has its item id, price in US dollars, AI score (beta), turnaround, required inputs, add-ons and why it matched. Use this when someone wants to send a press release to a newswire, find a PR distribution package, or choose news sites for an announcement, a sponsored article or a guest post. Do not use for scanning how a company is described online, or for ordering. Side effects: none; read only.

dofollow.description: Sites only: true for dofollow links. Example: true

goal.description: Rank for one goal: reputation, seo, ai_visibility or mentions. Example: "ai_visibility"

goal_weights.description: A goal mix instead of goal, each 0 to 100, scaled to 100. Example: {"ai_visibility": 60, "seo": 40}

language.description: An ISO 639-1 code or its English name, any case. Example: "en"

limit.description: At most this many results (default 10, at most 50). Example: 10

max_price_cents.description: Highest price per item, in US cents. Example: 50000

min_dr.description: Sites only: lowest DR (Ahrefs), 0 to 100; items without a DR never match. Example: 50

product_type.description: site (an article on one news site), pr_package (newswire or PR distribution), bundle, program (monthly) or service. Example: "pr_package"

query.description: Words to look for in the name, domain, category or description. Example: "newswire"

name: find_publications

dr.description: DR (Ahrefs), 0 to 100, for single sites; absent when we have no DR

tier.description: Our tier label for the AI score

title: Find publications
